title: Magic Pockets
description: Inventory Management Mod. increases base inventory, adds new enchantment, itemstack config, and storage system
body:
1.1 update showcase:

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/d2orbjyE5Tc" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

adds an extra row to the survival inventory:

![extra row in base inventory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/573e3f2c2425be083fad0083f2ed3554b1c11eb8.png)

*the modpack compatability version removes this specific feature because it is not added into 
any modded menus because of the way that the inventory is created (mojang hardcoded all of it).
if you're not having this issue, use the main release.

Magic Pockets Enchantment adds an additional slot per level of armor for a max of 16.

it can be enchanted at the enchanting table and found through the loot table
![pockets enchantment example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d041a715e42b0534e169de9540e7a0276df1613_0.webp)

new storage conduit system:

Storage Conduit:

![storage conduit crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ff98b15f5e0e337025057ae5ae0ef5c817772a3_0.webp)

Storage Conduit Connector:

![storage conduit connector crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f5e7bd4a400463e6ff58776ad7f4bd17d224b8fd_0.webp)

simple assembly of system:

![storage conduit system assembled](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a162399ec65ed92c6a8c2b4754e7f901cb8fbf96_0.webp)

Storage connectors will pick up any adjacent inventories and connect to one of the 5 sides of the conduit block (except the front), 
maximum of 20 connectors for each system

conduit interface:

![conduit screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/081c9347befac94fdda0c2563f48e29809c0f08d_0.webp)

right click on tab to rename tooltip, and right click with item to set the tab icon (can be any item)

config to change max itemstack:

![itemstack config](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/23851f536b12465684b2544a8c827d1c7037c3fd_0.webp)

values are 64 (default), 128 (default modded), 256, 512, 999, and 1 (challenge mode)

IF YOU ARE A MOD DEVELOPER AND WANT TO MAKE YOUR MOD MENUS COMPATIBLE WITH THIS MOD'S EXPANDED INVENTORY, HERE IS A GUIDE TO HELP YOU DO THAT: 
[mod compatabiliity doc](https://github.com/chewylopez/Pockets-Mod-1.21.1-Neoforge/blob/main/Magic%20Pockets%20compatability%20guide.pdf)
